description: This file defines configuration options and functions for initializing and customizing the PlatformService in the Mattermost server, including store overrides, configuration loading, logging, clustering, and metrics.

methods.name: StoreOverride
methods.description: Creates an Option to override the store used by PlatformService, accepting either a store.Store or a function returning a store.Store.

methods.name: StoreOverrideWithCache
methods.description: Creates an Option to override the store with a local cache layer wrapping the provided store.

methods.name: StoreOption
methods.description: Creates an Option to add sqlstore options when constructing the store.

methods.name: Config
methods.description: Creates an Option to set the configuration store from a DSN or file path, with optional defaults.

methods.name: SetFileStore
methods.description: Creates an Option to set the file backend store.

methods.name: SetExportFileStore
methods.description: Creates an Option to set the export file backend store.

methods.name: ConfigStore
methods.description: Creates an Option to directly set the configuration store, typically for testing.

methods.name: StartMetrics
methods.description: Creates an Option to enable metrics collection.

methods.name: SetLogger
methods.description: Creates an Option to set the logger for PlatformService.

methods.name: SetCluster
methods.description: Creates an Option to set the cluster interface.

methods.name: ForceEnableRedis
methods.description: Creates an Option to force enable Redis.
